ValidationRule.description: This rule prevents Sales reps from transitioning an Opportunity stage from "Identify" to any later stage without first adding products. This rule apply to: Panoramic/ GTDT - Sarge In-Depth/ TLR - Sarge Insight – Mahnaz
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula:
AND ( CASE( StageName, "Qualify", 1, "Evaluate", 1, "Negotiate", 1, "Contract Out", 1, "Closed Won – Pending Approval", 1, "Closed Won", 1, "Closed Won - Cancellation", 1, 0) = 1,
CASE ($User.Price_Book__c, "Expert Insight - Lexology Panoramic", 1, "Expert Insight - Lexology In-Depth", 1, "Expert Insight - GXRs", 1, 0)= 1,
NOT(HasOpportunityLineItem))
ValidationRule.errorMessage: To move opportunity stage from Identify, please add products.
